subject: Hosted API commit tiers & cross-region routing for Omega HealthTech
messages:
From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@omegahealthtech.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@omegahealthtech.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing + cross-region usage (initial info)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this. We're evaluating hosted API options to support our new ingestion pipelines and clinician-facing assistants. We expect a baseline of ~120M tokens/month today ramping to ~500M within 12 months. Traffic will be ~60% US, 30% EU, 10% APAC (edge requests from Singapore).

Main asks:
- Example committed tiers with per-token pricing (blended vs per-region)
- How cross-region usage is billed if traffic comes from several origins (do we bill where model executes, or origin region?)
- Any APAC premiums or separate SKUs for APAC?
- How fallback routing works if a region runs out of capacity (will requests route to another region and how is billing handled?)

Attached a small CSV with recent token histogram for reference.

We're aiming to make a commercial decision this month; happy to hop on a call.

Thanks,
Emily Tran
Head of Platform Procurement
Omega HealthTech

Attachment: omega_current-usage.csv (CSV, 24KB)

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@omegahealthtech.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + cross-region usage (initial info)

Hi Emily — great context, thanks for the CSV. High-level answers up front and then a brief pricing sketch so you have something to consider before we lock a time.

Short answers:
- Billing: tokens are charged where the inference executes; we support policy-based routing (route-by-region, cost-first, latency-first). You can also opt into "origin-billing" which maps tokens back to request origin for billing/chargeback, but that requires contract-level annotation.
- APAC: there is an APAC capacity premium driven by regional cloud costs and smaller instance pools; we can include APAC in a blended commit but it will have a modest uplift unless you commit a dedicated APAC pool.
- Fallbacks: requests can failover to a secondary region; by default billing follows execution region unless you request origin-billing. We recommend an SLA-driven fallback policy (e.g., prefer execution in-region, allow failover to EU if APAC is saturated).

Quick sketch (illustrative only, not final):
- On-demand (no commit): US $0.0012/token, EU $0.0014/token, APAC $0.0018/token
- Commit tiers (monthly committed tokens, blended price):
  * 50M/mo => $0.00095/token blended
  * 200M/mo => $0.00075/token blended
  * 500M/mo => $0.00062/token blended
Notes: APAC adds ~10-15% uplift on top of blended unless you take a dedicated APAC pool. Blended pricing assumes standard 60/30/10 split; if your split differs we can present a split-aware blended quote.

I'll attach a draft pricing annex to this thread. Aditya (copied) will jump in on commercial/levers. If it helps, I can schedule a 30-min call early next week to walk through routing and billing model.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-pricing-annex-v2.pdf (3 pages)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@omegahealthtech.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@omegahealthtech.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + cross-region usage (commercial terms)

Emily — appreciate the clear volume profile. A couple of commercial notes to accelerate:

1) Commit proposal: 12-month committed billing with quarterly true-ups. Example for 250M average committed/month (we can scale): blended $0.00070/token with a 2-tier protect for burst (up to 25% burst at blended+10%).

2) Region carve: If you require firm APAC capacity, we can reserve a dedicated APAC pool (adds ~$0.00008/token to blended and a small monthly pool fee). Otherwise we price APAC as a premium in blended rates.

3) First-quarter onboarding credit: we can offer 10% credit on billed usage in Q1 post-contract signing to offset migration/testing costs.

4) Discount floors: given platform-level commitments, the floor discount we can offer is 35% off list for the 500M tier; floors for smaller commitments are proportionally higher.

I'll put these terms into a short annex and share for review. If you can confirm target committed token number and a preferred split US/EU/APAC we'll produce a final blended quote.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Emily Tran <emily.tran@omegahealthtech.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 07:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + cross-region usage (technical constraints & options)

Adding some engineering detail so expectations are clear for the APAC behavior and routing policies: 

- Execution billing: as Soojin said, we bill where the model executes. If you choose origin-billing we add a small metadata tag on requests and report usage back to your preferred accounting sink.
- APAC premium drivers: smaller GPU pool sizes in APAC regions and higher reserve pricing for low-latency instances. If you need guaranteed p99 latency SLA for APAC, the dedicated APAC pool is required.
- Routing/fallback behavior: recommended pattern — primary: in-region (lowest latency), secondary: EU (if APAC saturated), tertiary: US (cost fallback). We can add a routing rule that preserves origin-billing semantics even if the execution region changes (so costs are attributed to the origin).
- Measurement: we can produce a breakdown at token-level per-region, per-model, per-route. We'll include sample CSV (demo-usage-report.csv) in the proposal so you can validate forecasting models.

If you opt for blended billing without dedicated APAC capacity, plan a 8–12% uplift in apparent overage vs forecast if you don't control routing policies (we'll show modeled numbers in the annex).

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@omegahealthtech.com>

Thanks — this is helpful. A few live asks from procurement before we take a legal/commercial pass: 

- Target commit: let's start with 200M/mo for 12 months with a planned ramp to 350M/mo by month 6. Proposed split: 60% US / 30% EU / 10% APAC (we can commit to those percentages for reporting).
- We want the onboarding credit (10% Q1) you mentioned, and a one-time technical validation credit to support our integration tests (estimate USD 10k).
- For billing we prefer origin-billing so internal teams can chargeback across product groups. Is that doable in contract?
- If you can provide a consolidated quote that shows blended vs split-by-region pricing (and a dedicated APAC pool option) we can present to procurement/legal.

Also please upload the deal to HubSpot and share the link (our procurement asks for a public-facing quote PDF + DocuSign link for countersign).

Can we schedule a 30-min call on Friday 27 Nov to finalize the annex? I can do 09:00–11:00 PT.

Regards,
Emily

Omega HealthTech
